svg.title: Microservices
svg.desc: Microservices. Small, independently deployable services, each owning one business capability and its data. Step 1, Split by capability: Split the monolith by business capability: each service gets its own code and its own database. Step 2, Independent deploy & scale: Payments ships v2 on its own while the others keep running; Catalog scales out to 3 instances. Step 3, Sync queries, async events: Queries are synchronous calls; a state change is an event that Payments and Inventory each react to. Step 4, Contain failures: Payments fails, yet orders are still accepted: their events wait in the broker until it catches up.

g.text: Split the monolith by business capability: each service gets its own code and its own database.
Payments ships v2 on its own while the others keep running; Catalog scales out to 3 instances.
Queries are synchronous calls; a state change is an event that Payments and Inventory each react to.
Payments fails, yet orders are still accepted: their events wait in the broker until it catches up.
